name: Frostfang's Cavern
description: An ice cave at the western foot of the massif. Wampas den in its tunnels under the elder the scavengers call Frostfang.

name: Icemaw's Den
description: The deepest of the ice caves: a long descent through wampa dens to the lair of the elder known as Icemaw.

name: Snowblind's Lair
description: A wampa den in the ice caves. The pack here hunts in the blizzards that give the lair its name.

name: The Matriarch's Cavern
description: The largest of the ice caves and the heart of the wampa dens. The matriarch of the massif holds its last chamber.

name: The Ice Caves
description: The ice caves of the northern massif: four wampa dens cut into the glacier.

name: Mynock Den
description: A cave in the southern mynock fields where ice mynocks roost in their thousands.

name: Glacial Rancor Grounds
description: A glacial valley south of the outpost. Scavengers tell of a rancor that hunts here.

name: Imperial Forward Camp
description: Snowtrooper forward camp on the eastern plains: patrols, a salvage detail and an Imperial recruiter.

name: Rebel Forward Camp
description: Rebel forward camp in the northwest: snow soldiers, a sergeant and an Alliance recruiter.

name: Scavengers' Camp
description: Camp of the Scavenger Starport's salvage crews, southwest of the outpost. A junk dealer trades here.

name: Raiders' Camp
description: Camp of the scavenger raiders who prey on salvage crews and travellers in the southwest.

name: Contested Ground
description: The skirmish line between the Imperial and Rebel patrols. Expect fighting.

name: Lucky Despot Wreck
description: The debris field beside the Scavenger Starport, picked over by the outpost's salvage detail.

name: Western Tauntaun Plains
description: Open snowfields west of the outpost where tauntaun herds graze: the easiest hunting on Hoth.

name: Eastern Tauntaun Plains
description: Open snowfields east of the outpost where tauntaun herds graze.

name: Mynock Fields
description: The southern fields where ice mynock packs roost and raiders camp.

name: Western Wampa Flanks
description: The foothills below the ice caves, hunting ground of the wampas.

name: Southeastern Wampa Flanks
description: The foothills southeast of the ice caves, hunting ground of the wampas.

name: Imperial Patrol Zone
description: Snowtrooper patrols and salvage teams work this eastern ground.

name: Rebel Patrol Zone
description: Rebel snow patrols hold the northwest.

name: Scavenger Country
description: Scavenger country southwest of the outpost: raider camps, tauntaun herds and mynock packs.
